title: Debt Snowball vs. Debt Avalanche: Comparing Payoff Strategies
summary: GREEN-L2-018: Debt Snowball vs. Debt Avalanche: Comparing Payoff Strategies.
body: This GREEN Level 2 lesson develops practical competence in Debt Snowball vs. Debt Avalanche: Comparing Payoff Strategies. Learners should connect income, spending, saving, taxation, cash flow, risk, timing and longer-term financial goals rather than treating personal-finance decisions in isolation. Tax rules, allowances, account structures and consumer protections vary by jurisdiction and can change, so current official information or qualified local professional advice should be used where relevant. The objective is applied reasoning: know the numbers, test assumptions, examine downside scenarios and make deliberate financial decisions.
